title: ECP-Bench: Benchmarking and Learning Entertainment Content Promotion with Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.22150v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Content promotion spans a broad set of skills, from understanding content to forecasting its market reception. However, LLMs' ability to support such promotion decisions remains underexplored. Existing studies are often limited to a single task (e.g., popularity prediction) or a small set of tasks within a single domain (e.g., movies). As a result, there is a lack of understanding of LLMs' abilities in the full promotion process and how these abilities generalize across different tasks and domains. In this work, we introduce ECP-Bench, a benchmark containing 1.9M movie, game, and music items and 423,451 questions across 33 tasks in five content-promotion skill families. Our evaluation shows that frontier models achieve only 51.9\% overall accuracy and lose much of their advantage on post-cutoff content, with drops of up to 19.1 percentage points. translated_title: ECP-Bench：基于基础模型的娱乐内容推广基准测试与学习
translated_abstract: 内容推广涵盖广泛的技能，从理解内容到预测其市场反响。然而，大语言模型（LLM）在支持此类推广决策方面的能力仍未得到充分探索。现有研究通常仅限于单一任务（如流行度预测）或单一领域（如电影）内的少量任务。因此，人们对LLM在完整推广流程中的能力，以及这些能力如何在不同任务和领域间泛化，缺乏了解。在这项工作中，我们提出了ECP-Bench，这是一个包含190万个电影、游戏和音乐项目、423,451个问题、覆盖五大内容推广技能家族共33个任务的基准测试。我们的评估显示，前沿模型的整体准确率仅为51.9%，并且在训练截止日期之后发布的内容上失去了大部分优势，下降幅度高达19.1个百分点。相比之下，在ECP-Bench上微调的开源权重模型最高可达到60.3%，并保持显
tldr: 该论文提出ECP-Bench基准（含190万个娱乐内容项目、42万余个问题、33个任务），评估发现前沿LLM在内容推广任务上准确率仅51.9%且对训练截止后的内容大幅下降，而在该基准上微调的开源模型反而能达到60.3%的更高准确率。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ECP-Bench, a benchmark with 1.9M entertainment items and 423K questions across 33 tasks, revealing that frontier LLMs achieve only 51.9% accuracy on content promotion and degrade on post-cutoff content, while open-weight models fine-tuned on it reach up to 60.3%.
